enrichment method: Immunoprecipitates of HA-TJP1 were prepared for MS studies as previously reported and analyzed by electrospray ionization tandem MS on a Thermo LTQ Orbitrap instrument.
instrument: analyzed by electrospray ionization tandem MS on a Thermo LTQ Orbitrap instrument.
ionization type: analyzed by electrospray ionization tandem MS on a Thermo LTQ Orbitrap instrument.
labeling: The MS proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifier PXD016917 and PXD016919.
mass analyzer: analyzed by electrospray ionization tandem MS on a Thermo LTQ Orbitrap instrument.
ptm: Immunoprecipitates of FLAG-PER1 and FLAG-CRY1 were used to determine phospho-site (s) by MS.
